observations.posthog_connection: This change improves Bing Webmaster Tools warehouse ingestion by resolving bare-hostname entries against the account's verified sites. It distinguishes between a single verified match (resolved) and multiple verified matches (ambiguous, raising an error). This prevents silent mismatches or guessing the scheme when a host has multiple verified variants.
